description.zh: 要释放的公网连接串（可选，不传则自动释放 Mem0 公网地址）
description.en: The public endpoint to be released. This parameter is optional. If this parameter is not specified, the public endpoint of Mem0 is automatically released.

description.zh: 实例所在地域id。>您可以调用[describeregions](~~196841~~)接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the details of regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

title.zh: 关闭记忆引擎公网地址
title.en: Release the public endpoint of the memory engine

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于在回滚任务前，确认无任何活跃连接以保障操作安全。
descriptions.en: This operation is used to verify that no active connections exist before a rollback task to ensure operational safety.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx release-mem0-public-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-htri00000r4k9p --current-connection-string pxc-hzjasdyuoo.polarx.rds.aliyuncs.com --region cn-hangzhou
